issueContext.title: Add per-account rate limiting to login endpoint
issueContext.body:
## Background

Login endpoint is currently unrestricted, allowing brute-force attempts.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Login endpoint rejects requests after 5 failures within 60 seconds with HTTP 429
- [ ] Counter resets after 60-second window elapses

## Non-goals

- Does not rate-limit by IP
- Does not rate-limit other auth endpoints
